notes: CBACT02C on GENERATED inputs (#3804): the input file is built from the CVACT02Y record layout (edge values first, unique keys in key order) instead of CardDemo's data file, proving the carddemo-readcard port on records it was not written against. CBACT02C reads the card master and DISPLAYs each record; its FD declares the record inline (two items), so the layout is the copybook it reads INTO. The card number is generated as digits only (as a card number is), so the key order is the same on both sides (letters sort before digits in EBCDIC, after them in ASCII).
